get.description: Admin detail for a single job, including the raw enqueue assertion token (`authorityAssertion`) stored with the authority grant. List responses omit that token to keep payloads small. Mounted as monolith chrome (`site-admin-only`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Short id of the job to retrieve.

200.description: Job detail including the enqueue assertion evidence.

authorityAssertion.description: Enqueue-hop identity assertion as stored with the job (payload, signature, keyId). Detail-only; omitted from list.

signature.description: Base64url HMAC-SHA256 signature of the payload.

keyId.description: Id of the key used to sign the assertion.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid auth headers, or not logged in.

job.description: Wire form of a queued API-call job. CamelCase projection of the `job` row; omits internal columns (`heartbeatAt`, `updatedAt`). Authority is the discriminated evidence grant without the raw enqueue assertion token (detail endpoints may return that separately as `authorityAssertion`).

id.description: Short identifier for the job (from generateShortId).

status.description: Lifecycle state. `pending`/`retrying` are claimable; `running` is in delivery; `succeeded`/`dead`/`cancelled` are terminal.

operationId.description: Target OpenAPI operationId resolved at delivery time.

request.description: Capped request payload delivered to the target operation (serialized size ≤ 16 KB). Path params, query, and body are optional and substituted into the operation's path template / request.

pathParams.description: Path template substitutions keyed by parameter name.

query.description: Query string parameters keyed by name.

body.description: JSON request body for the target operation, when any.

userId.description: Acting user whose authority the job runs under.

authority.description: Root grant for the job chain (copied verbatim by children). Discriminated on `kind`. Wire form excludes the embedded enqueue assertion token.

oneOf.description: A user's authenticated request (or an admin action) instigated the chain. Evidence is the originating request id (also in the audit log).

userId.description: User who made the originating request.

oneOf.description: A webhook arrived for a channel subscription; the importer's creator authorized scanning this channel. Evidence is the importer row.

userId.description: Importer creator whose authority is used.

importerId.description: Short id of the importer row that authorized the chain.

oneOf.description: A cron tick fired for an enabled job; the admin who last enabled it is the recorded authority. Evidence is the cron job name.

userId.description: Admin who enabled the cron job (`enabled_by`).

cronJobName.description: Name of the cron job that enqueued this chain.

originalRequestId.description: Chain-root request id (user request / webhook X-Request-ID, or cron-tick id). Copied from parent on chained enqueues; joins audit_event.request_id.

enqueuedByOperationId.description: Calling operationId that enqueued this job (trigger-map edge).

parentJobId.description: Short id of the job that enqueued this one, or null at the chain root.

runAt.description: Earliest time the job may be claimed for delivery.

dedupeKey.description: Optional key unique among non-terminal jobs. Re-enqueue with the same live key upserts (pushes runAt, refreshes request) and returns the existing job.

concurrencyKey.description: Optional key limiting concurrency: at most one running job per key (e.g. `matter:{id}`).

priority.description: Claim priority; higher values are claimed first. Default 0.

attempt.description: Number of delivery attempts consumed so far (0 before first claim).

maxAttempts.description: Maximum delivery attempts before the job becomes dead (exhausted).

result.description: Outcome of the latest terminal or failed attempt. Null while the job has not yet finished an attempt that records a result. `errorBody` is set only on failure and capped at 8 KB.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code from the delivery attempt, when available.

errorBody.description: Capped error response body recorded only on failure.

terminalReason.description: Why the job became terminal. Null when the job succeeded or result is from a non-terminal retryable failure mid-flight.

createdAt.description: When the job row was created.

startedAt.description: When the current (or last) delivery attempt started; null if never claimed.

finishedAt.description: When the job reached a terminal status; null while still active.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.
